meta.title: docs: Add IAVL v1 migration guide for consensus node operators
meta.body_summary: Adds documentation for consensus node operators on migrating from IAVL v0 to v1 in celestia-app v4, covering lazy migration and state sync options; later simplified and moved to v4 release notes per review.

perf_labels.notes: Copilot authored a detailed IAVL v1 migration guide; evan-forbes requested drastic simplification and relocation to release notes; after iterative reductions, PR merged with minimal essential content.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 3672 changed lines, this appears as a large change, but most deletions are merge artifacts (removing local_devnet). The actual documentation change is small; the PR merged after simplification aligning with maintainer expectations for minimal, focused guidance.

review_details.concern_detail: Maintainer evan-forbes repeatedly requested simplification, removing performance analysis, detailed instructions, and moving content to release notes; he wanted only essential info for node operators.
review_details.performance_claim: IAVL v1 provides roughly 10x performance improvement over v0.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Documentation PR required multiple rounds of maintainer feedback to reduce verbosity and relocate content; agent followed instructions but initial output was overly detailed and in wrong file, highlighting the need for project-specific conventions.

detection_detail.code_reading: evan-forbes and rootulp reviewed the markdown content, requested deletion of verbose sections, and relocation to release notes.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurement or benchmark; PR is documentation only and the 10x claim was not independently verified in the review process.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No software regression; documentation changes only.

core_change_summary.description: Added an IAVL v1 migration guide in docs/maintainers/iavl-v1-migration.md, then drastically reduced content per review and moved essential info to docs/release-notes/release-notes.md as a short subsection. Also merged main branch changes that brought in unrelated files.
core_change_summary.secondary_note: Most file deletions (local_devnet, scripts) are from merge commits and not directly related to the documentation change; they represent removal of devnet configuration that was already on main.
change_trajectory: Initial commit added comprehensive migration guide with 279 lines.
Enhancement commit added configuration options and multiplexer details.
After evan-forbes' detailed inline review requesting simplification, the guide was reduced to 97 lines by removing performance analysis and detailed instructions.
Further simplification per review: lazy migration process section reduced to one sentence, prerequisites removed, migration options compressed.
Moved the content from standalone file to a subsection of the v4.0.0 release notes, deleting the original file.
Additional minor wording adjustments per rootulp and cmwaters reviews.
Resolved merge conflicts, which brought in numerous other repository changes (including removal of local_devnet).

review_signals.summary: Requested to redo the guide, focus only on what node operators need to do to switch, remove performance analysis and verbose pros/cons.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot simplified guide significantly, reducing from 308 to 97 lines.

review_signals.summary: Instructed to append the migration guide to v4.0.0 release notes instead of a separate file.
review_signals.action_taken: Copilot deleted the standalone file and added a brief section to release-notes.md.

review_signals.summary: Suggested clarifying the lazy migration wording from 'automatically' to 'lazily over time'.
Approved the high-level approach, noting that for node operators less is more.

collaboration_trajectory: Copilot opened PR with a standalone, detailed migration guide (308 lines).
Within 21 minutes, evan-forbes requested a complete redo, stripping all performance analysis and verbose sections.
Copilot responded with a simplified 97-line version; further inline comments led to reducing the lazy migration process to one sentence.
The next day, evan-forbes asked to move the content into the v4.0.0 release notes; Copilot deleted the guide file and added a short paragraph.
rootulp and cmwaters provided minor wording suggestions; tac0turtle endorsed the high-level approach.
After resolving a merge conflict, the PR was approved and merged after ~4 days.
